caption: Negative control: this folder preserves an intentionally conflicting abstract scene. The invariant claims one coherent shimmering puzzle surface with stable interlocking pieces and a consistent reflective tabletop, while shot captions may pull toward incompatible object layouts. A consistency win without adherence loss here is text-override evidence, never a method pass. Added invariant: The same festive indoor setting with a decorated Christmas tree and scattered green puzzle pieces remains consistent across all shots.
contrast_caption: The puzzle surface becomes a different object, landscape, animal, person, liquid, room, or unrelated abstract material.
invariant_caption: The same coherent shimmering puzzle surface remains on the same reflective tabletop with stable interlocking pieces and consistent highlights. Added invariant: The same festive indoor setting with a decorated Christmas tree and scattered green puzzle pieces remains consistent across all shots.
